question.problem:
Which of the following integers belong to the residue class $[4]_{7}?$

- $-3$
- $6$
- $18$
question.worked_solution:
The residue class $[4]_{7}$ consists of the elements that are congruent to $4$ modulo $7.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[4]_{7} & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡4\,(\text{mod}\,7)} \\  & ={x\in Z\,|\,x=4+7k,\,k\in Z} \\  & ={4+7k\,|\,k\in Z} \\  & ={…,\,4-2\cdot 7,\,4-7,\,4,\,4+7,\,4+2\cdot 7,\,…} \\  & ={…,-10,-3,4,11,18,…}.\end{aligned}
$$

We see that $-3$ and $18$ belong to $[4]_{7},$ while $6$ does not.

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and III only".
